description: This file defines API routes for a gym management system's workouts module, including endpoints for exercises, templates, programs, and program days, using FastAPI and SQLAlchemy.

methods.name: create_exercise_endpoint( payload: ws.ExerciseCreate, db: Session = Depends(get_db), trainer=Depends(require_trainer), )
methods.description: Create a new exercise owned by the trainer.

methods.name: list_exercises_endpoint( page: int = Query(1, ge=1, description="Page number"), page_size: int = Query(20, ge=1, le=100, description="Page size"), db: Session = Depends(get_db), trainer=Depends(require_trainer), )
methods.description: List exercises owned by the authenticated trainer with pagination.

methods.name: create_template_endpoint( payload: ws.WorkoutTemplateCreate, db: Session = Depends(get_db), trainer=Depends(require_trainer), )
methods.description: Create a workout template owned by the trainer, optionally including initial exercises.

methods.name: list_templates_endpoint( page: int = Query(1, ge=1), page_size: int = Query(20, ge=1, le=100), db: Session = Depends(get_db), trainer=Depends(require_trainer), )
methods.description: List workout templates owned by the trainer with pagination.

methods.name: add_template_exercise_endpoint( template_id: int = Path(..., description="Template ID"), payload: ws.TemplateExerciseCreate = None, db: Session = Depends(get_db), trainer=Depends(require_trainer), )
methods.description: Add an exercise to a workout template (trainer-only).

methods.name: delete_template_exercise_endpoint( template_id: int = Path(..., description="Template ID"), template_exercise_id: int = Path(..., description="Template exercise ID"), db: Session = Depends(get_db), trainer=Depends(require_trainer), )
methods.description: Remove an exercise from a workout template.

methods.name: assign_program_endpoint( payload: ws.ProgramCreate, db: Session = Depends(get_db), trainer=Depends(require_trainer), )
methods.description: Create and assign a program to a member user, optionally seeding from a template.

methods.name: list_my_programs_endpoint( page: int = Query(1, ge=1), page_size: int = Query(20, ge=1, le=100), db: Session = Depends(get_db), current_user=Depends(get_current_user), )
methods.description: Members can view their own programs with pagination.

methods.name: list_programs_for_trainer_endpoint( page: int = Query(1, ge=1), page_size: int = Query(20, ge=1, le=100), db: Session = Depends(get_db), trainer=Depends(require_trainer), )
methods.description: Trainers can list programs they created for clients.

methods.name: create_program_day_endpoint( program_id: int = Path(..., description="Program ID"), payload: ws.ProgramDayCreate = None, db: Session = Depends(get_db), trainer=Depends(require_trainer), )
methods.description: Add a day to a program (trainer-only).

methods.name: list_program_days_endpoint( program_id: int = Path(..., description="Program ID"), page: int = Query(1, ge=1), page_size: int = Query(20, ge=1, le=100), db: Session = Depends(get_db), current_user=Depends(get_current_user), )
methods.description: List days in a program, accessible by the program owner or member.

methods.name: add_program_day_exercise_endpoint( program_id: int = Path(..., description="Program ID"), day_id: int = Path(..., description="Program Day ID"), payload: ws.ProgramDayExerciseCreate = None, db: Session = Depends(get_db), trainer=Depends(require_trainer), )
methods.description: Add an exercise to a specific program day.

methods.name: list_program_day_exercises_endpoint( program_id: int = Path(..., description="Program ID"), day_id: int = Path(..., description="Program Day ID"), page: int = Query(1, ge=1), page_size: int = Query(50, ge=1, le=100), db: Session = Depends(get_db), current_user=Depends(get_current_user), )
methods.description: List exercises within a program day for trainer/member visibility.
